intro: Import an existing mapping (source_to_concept_map, CONCEPT + CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP, SSSOM, Usagi, a Linkr mapping project, any table, or a plain list of concept ids) to see which projects it covers: a concept set counts as covered when one of its concepts, at the version the project pins, is mapped.
storage_server: Imports are shared with every user of this instance.
load_error: The imported mappings could not be loaded.
empty_description: Import a mapping file to evaluate the coverage of each project.
name: Name
delete_description: "{{name}}" and its rows will be deleted. The file itself is not affected.
delete_error: The import could not be deleted.
import_description: Drop the file(s), check the detected format, then the columns and the preview.
drop_hint: Drop files here or click to choose

format_hints.generic: Any table: pick the column holding the target concept ids (several ids per cell are split on ; , | or spaces), and the source columns you have.
format_hints.stcm: OMOP source_to_concept_map, with or without Linkr's source_domain_id column. target_concept_id 0 = unmapped; rows with an invalid_reason are skipped.
format_hints.ccr: OMOP CONCEPT (your local 2-billion concepts) and CONCEPT_RELATIONSHIP: valid 'Maps to' and 'Maps to value' rows are the mappings. Two files, or a ZIP.
format_hints.sssom: SSSOM TSV: object_id with an OMOP prefix (OHDSI:, OMOP:, or one the curie_map points at OHDSI). sssom:NoTermFound = unmapped; predicate_modifier Not = skipped.
format_hints.usagi: Usagi export: by default only APPROVED rows count (change it once imported).
format_hints.linkr: A Linkr mapping project (folder ZIP with entity.json + mappings.json, or its JSON export). By default only approved mappings count.
format_hints.concept_ids: One concept id per line, as v1 imported it: no source information.

column_roles_hint: Which column holds what. Guessed from the header names: check them.
